text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After the race concluded—thunderous applause echoed throughout Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hah... hah...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Members
text_block_list.text:
Ready, and!
Lord Fuji, nice ruuuun!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, I took such an awesome video!
I'm gonna upload it right away!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Next was the Tenno Sho (Autumn), right?
I've gotta take some time off!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone believed in Fuji Kiseki's talent,
and everyone held high hopes for her next race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst all this, something was bothering me.
During the Yasuda Kinen race—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her running form seemed different, at a level
that you wouldn't notice unless you watched her every day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I hurried to the underground paddock pathway after Fuji Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —However...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
She went back ahead.
Said something about needing to make adjustments.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I was told to pass along a message
telling you not to worry.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...Look, as fellow dorm heads,
I'm on reasonably good terms with her."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So I'd like to think I understand a bit.
Doesn't she seem kinda off right now?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Right...
Not like she'd spill anything to me anyway.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It has to be you, after all.
Please take care of Fuji!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hurriedly followed Fuji Kiseki
and headed back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next up is finally the middle-distance Tenno Sho (Autumn).
However, before that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I need to check what's happening to Fuji Kiseki right now...!
